This endpoint that will be suffixed on to the URL of the Marketing Cloud REST API to perform email address validation. Note that this value has a placeholder in it for the version, which is retrieved from the "MarketingCloudVersion" site preference. This is done so that all Marketing Cloud endpoints don't have to be updated when the version changes. For example, this value will likely be "/address/v{0}/validateEmail". When combined, the URL will be something like: "https://mcz7rh6w0pl2bf9gj8k6493r-5h4.rest.marketingcloudapis.com/address/v1/validateEmail"

attribute-definition.display-name: Use Marketing Cloud for Account Creation Email
attribute-definition.description: If true, then the account creation email will be sent through SFMC. If false, then the default behavior will be applied; sending through SFCC.

attribute-definition.display-name: Use Marketing Cloud for Gift Certificate
attribute-definition.description: If true, then the gift certificate email will be sent through SFMC. If false, then the default behavior will be applied; sending through SFCC.

attribute-definition.display-name: Journey Entry Event Key for Newsletter
attribute-definition.description: The journey key for sending Newsletter Emails stored in JSON by brandId. There are two options allowed formats: Option 1 (For Multibrand): [{"BrandId":"examplebrand1","Key":"Example_Brand1_WelcomeSeriesEvent"},{"BrandId":"examplebrand2","Key":"Example_Brand2_WelcomeSeriesEvent"}] Option 2 (Non-Multibrand): WelcomeSeriesEvent If multibrand is configured you must follow the above JSON standard to allow all brands to have their own external keys.

attribute-definition.display-name: Data Extension External Key for Newsletter
attribute-definition.description: (Using this preference will disable the Journey Event) The external key for sending Newsletter Emails stored in JSON by brandId. There are two options allowed formats: Option 1 (For Multibrand): [{"BrandId":"examplebrand1","Key":"Example_Brand1_Confirmation"},{"BrandId":"examplebrand2","Key":"Example_Brand2_Confirmation"}] Option 2 (Non-Multibrand): Example_Brand_Confirmation If multibrand is configured you must follow the above JSON standard to allow all brands to have their own external keys.
If true, then the newsletter email will be sent through SFMC. If false, then the default behavior will be applied; trigger via SFRA Hook.
